hypothesis: A full linear functional over the 126 normalized work-function coordinates can repair the three residual taxi inequalities while preserving the complete-circle constraints, even though the smaller symmetry-aware feature cone cannot.
rationale: The preceding 16-feature correction was infeasible, but that result does not distinguish a genuinely envelope-level obstruction from excessive feature compression. A full configuration-coordinate functional is the smallest explicit expressivity diagnostic that tests this distinction without changing the frozen evaluator or fitting arbitrary per-node values.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether additive correction fails because of the mechanism or only because the symmetry-aware basis is too small. Feasible models earn full taxi evaluation; a strict improvement would trigger primary-evaluator and generalization checks, while infeasibility closes additive linear repair entirely for this residual setup.
method: Use the fixed published n=5 min-envelope potential as the base and add a bounded L1-regularized linear functional over all 126 normalized work-function coordinates for sorted 4-server multisets on m=6. Solve exactly four LPs: all three residual taxi edges and each residual pair, while enforcing every 6006 complete-circle inequality. Coefficients are bounded to [-10,10]. Evaluate every feasible correction over all 7,000,602 taxi inequalities; primary-evaluate only a strict target result. The candidate source maps the learned m=6 coordinates deterministically when invoked on other metric sizes for later adversarial generalization checks.
metric: complete-circle violations_k and frozen circle-taxi violations_k; target is taxi violations_k < 3
metric_relation_to_true_objective: The complete-circle LP constraints are finite feasibility gates. Only a full frozen taxi count below 3 is strict finite objective improvement; no finite evaluator result proves the full k-server conjecture.

configuration.feature_definition: all sorted 4-server multiset coordinates on m=6

compute_budget.cpu: WSL2 pinned metric arrays; four LP models and conditional full taxi evaluation
compute_budget.memory_intent: bounded linear diagnostic without evaluator or metric changes

kill_condition: Stop after the four declared LP models, at 1800 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not add features, relax bounds, or select constraints after seeing results. If no model is feasible, close additive linear repair. If feasible models exist, evaluate only those models on every taxi edge and primary-evaluate only a count below 3.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: only a full taxi count below 3 is strict improvement

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: this is a new full-coordinate additive diagnostic around the prior-art baseline

interpretation: All four bounded LP models were infeasible: no full 126-coordinate additive correction can preserve every complete-circle inequality while repairing all three or any pair of the residual taxi edges. No taxi candidate was produced and no objective improvement is claimed.
what_was_learned: The additive repair hypothesis is closed for both the 16-feature symmetry-aware cone and the full m=6 configuration-coordinate space. The residual mechanism cannot be repaired by adding a linear work-function functional without changing the envelope structure.
recommended_next_action: Move to one bounded nonlinear envelope-switching experiment that combines the verified n=5 potential with published canonical alternatives; if it produces no strict improvement, pause k-server pending a more fundamental construction.
repetition_justification: This is a bounded expressivity diagnostic over all configuration coordinates, not an expansion of the previous 16-feature pairwise-distance family or a coefficient perturbation sweep.
